local services = tool('list_services', {})

for _, svc in ipairs(services) do

  local page = 1
  local total_errors = 0
  local by_hour = {}
  local total_pages = 1
  repeat
    local r = tool('search_logs', { service = svc, level = 'ERROR', page = page })
    total_pages = r.total_pages
    total_errors = r.total_items
    for _, item in ipairs(r.items) do
      local hour = item.ts and string.sub(item.ts, 1, 13) or 'unknown'

    if page > 5 then break end
  until page > total_pages

  local deploys = tool('get_deploys', { service = svc })
  results[#results + 1] = {
    service = svc,
    total_errors = total_errors,
    by_hour_sample = by_hour,
    deploys = deploys
  }
end

return results
